text:
sam_h: quick thought  can the edge emit a small signed claim like `serve-from=region` so origins can skip a control-plane residency lookup for common read paths?

jin_lee: interesting. edge-signed only? we should avoid trusting client SDKs for this.

maria_g: +1 edge-signed. example header: `X-RW-Region-Claim: v=1;r=eu-west-1;tid=acct-42;exp=1712000000;sig=...` HMAC over `v|r|tid|exp`. compact and fast.

raul_ops: rollout: start in log-only for readonly endpoints (embeddings/search), then tenant opt-in. metrics: claim.accepted, claim.rejected, claim.expired.

nina_sec: security checklist: short TTL (60s), nonce or monotonic ts to limit replay, audit events, and never use claim to override declared residency in control plane. redact tenant ids in aggregated logs.

lara_legal: confirm: claim must be advisory unless tenant policy allows it. also need consent checkbox in tenant console + audit log when used to short-circuit.

jin_lee: key mgmt: rotate edge signing keys via KMS. publish key material for origins via signed JWKS or distribute short-lived HMAC secrets. include grace window for rollover.

maria_g: cache behavior: origin keeps local tenant policy for 30s default. control-plane push for invalidation on residency change. target staleness SLA <= 60s for critical flips.

raul_ops: ops playbook stub: how to trace invalid claims, how to flush origin cache, and how to disable claim acceptance cluster-wide.

sam_h: open questions: header name/format, HMAC vs JWT, TTL, observability, and legal guardrails. I'll draft an RFC and pilot plan.

infra-bot: created draft RFC at https://rfd.redwood.internal/rfcs/edge-region-claim-5172008888 (draft).

lara_legal: I'll review the RFC for audit/consent language once it's up.

sam_h: thanks all  will post RFC link here when ready and schedule a 30m sync.
